Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Resolve macOS APFS path mismatch in configuration resolution

On macOS APFS, the workspace folder URI often carries a trailing slash while file URIs do not. This discrepancy causes `IUriIdentityService.extUri.relativePath` and `ILabelService.getUriLabel` to fail path computation, resulting in breadcrumbs rendering absolute paths (e.g., `/Volumes/<vol>/...`) instead of relative ones.

Update `ResolveConfiguration` to strip a single trailing slash from the resolved workspace folder URI. This ensures the workspace root aligns with the workbench's file URI normalization strategy, restoring correct relative path display in the breadcrumb and label services.

This aligns the configuration logic with the Tauri IPC substrate's path handling requirements established in the recent migration.

Completed the migration from Electron to Tauri by establishing the full workbench communication substrate. Added 24 routed IPC channels and 14 stub channels to `TauriMainProcessService.ts` to handle core services (filesystem, storage, configuration, extensions, lifecycle) without crashing on missing handlers. Introduced 5 streaming subscriptions for live renderer feeds (VFS, configuration, terminal, lifecycle) to avoid round-tripping invokes.

Regenerated all workbridge shapes, command catalogs, and service schemas via the codegen pipeline, updating versions to 2026-05-03. Implemented concrete Effect-TS live layers for UserSettings, WorkbenchActivity, Clipboard, Command, ContextKey, Dialog, Editor, Extension, Host, Keybinding, Layout, Lifecycle, Notification, Product, Progress, Storage, Theme, and Workspace services. All services now resolve bridges from `globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__` injected by the preload script.

Refactored build configuration to standardize ESBuild targets and environment constants. Removed 1,076 lines of legacy Electron polyfills now superseded by Mountain-routed channels. Updated telemetry event namespaces to `land:*` and enforced development-only gating for capture functions to ensure production builds contain no telemetry payloads.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Strip trailing slash from workspace folder URI parameter

Mountain's `BuildInitialUrl` sources the initial workspace from `~/.land/workspaces/RecentlyOpened.json`, which stores URIs with a trailing slash. After stripping the `file://` scheme and percent-encoding the path for the `?folder=` query parameter, the decoded value still ends in `/`. On macOS APFS, a workspace folder URI with a trailing slash prevents `IUriIdentityService.extUri.relativePath` and `ILabelService.getUriLabel` from computing relative paths, causing breadcrumbs to render absolute `/Volumes/...` paths instead of workspace-relative segments like `Source > Foo > Bar`.

Normalize the decoded `folder` value by stripping trailing slashes (preserving a bare root `/`) before constructing the URI. Tighten the `Workspace` identifier guard to only build the object when a normalized folder parameter is present.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Reduce IPC logging to prevent channel saturation during extension boot

The Tauri IPC channel was being saturated during extension boot by excessive _DevLogForward calls:
- Successful "tauri-invoke" completions logged every invoke (redundant - Mountain's Rust side already logs ok/fail with ns precision via `[DEV:IPC] done:`)
- All fire-and-forget channel stubs logged (noop/value cases are routine)

This caused keystroke lag as user input queued behind the log noise on the shared WebKit message channel. Fix removes:
- Success-case tauri-invoke forward (failures still forwarded - stack traces are worth the cost)
- Fire-and-forget channel stub logging entirely
- Only forward `drift` disposition case (the noteworthy scenario)

Catalog version bumped to 2026-05-01 reflecting codegen run.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add codegen bridge shape generation and WorkbenchProduct/Progress services

Phase-3 of Wind's VS Code service codegen pipeline: generate
`Workbench<X>BridgeShape.ts` files as `Pick<...Upstream, ...>`
over the generated upstream schema, eliminating hand-maintained bridge
shapes and ensuring upstream API changes surface as TypeScript build
errors.

Codegen additions:
- EmitBridgeShape: Generates `Pick<...>` bridge shape files derived
  from codegen-emitted upstream schemas
- EmitBridgeShapeBatch: Batch emitter driven by a curated manifest
- WorkbenchBridgeShapeManifest: Developer-curated narrowing of which
  upstream members each Wind service consumes (18 entries)
- ResolveInterfaceCrossFile: Fallback resolver when interface lives in
  imported file rather than alongside decorator
- IterateServiceDecorators: Updated to use cross-file resolution
- RunCodegen: Orchestrator now runs bridge shape emission after schema
  generation

New Wind services:
- WorkbenchProductService: Bridges IProductService for product metadata
  (name, version, commit, date, quality, extensionsGallery)
- WorkbenchProgressService: Bridges IProgressService for progress tasks
  with location handling (Explorer, Scm, Extensions, Window, etc.)

Both services follow the established pattern with BridgeShape, Service,
Interface, Tag, Problem, and Live implementations. LandWorkbenchLayer
and LandWorkbenchTags updated to include all newly-added services.

prepublishOnly.sh now runs codegen (Stage 1b) before the production
build, ensuring generated schemas + bridge shapes are fresh.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add WorkbenchContextKey, WorkbenchExtension, WorkbenchLayout, and WorkbenchProgress services

Add four new workbench-tier Effect-TS service layers bridging VS Code's native workbench services:

WorkbenchContextKeyService:
- Manages context key values (Get/Set/Reset) and context expression evaluation
- Reads from globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.ContextKey bridge
- Problem ADT: WorkbenchContextKeyBridgeUnavailable, WorkbenchContextKeyEvalFailed

WorkbenchExtensionService:
- Extension activation and snapshot management
- Provides Snapshot (all extensions), Activate, ActivateByEvent, OnExtensionsChange stream
- Problem ADT: WorkbenchExtensionBridgeUnavailable, WorkbenchExtensionActivationFailed

WorkbenchLayoutService:
- Controls workbench part visibility (ActivityBar, Sidebar, Panel, StatusBar, etc.)
- Provides Snapshot (visibility map), SetVisible, Toggle, Changes stream
- Includes WorkbenchLayoutPartId mapping and WorkbenchLayoutAllParts constant
- Problem ADT: WorkbenchLayoutBridgeUnavailable, WorkbenchLayoutToggleFailed

WorkbenchProgressProblem:
- Add Problem ADT for progress task failures

Also completes WorkbenchEditorService with the Live implementation bridging to VS Code's editor service for pane management (Active, Open, CloseActive, OnActiveChange).

All services follow the established Wind pattern with BridgeShape (upstream typed interface), Service (abstract contract), Tag (Context.Tag for DI), Problem (ADT for errors), and Live (runtime bridge implementation).

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add WorkbenchActivity and WorkbenchEditor services

Add two new workbench-tier Effect-TS service layers bridging VS Code's native activity and editor services:

WorkbenchActivityService:
- Manages activity badges for view containers, views, accounts, and global activity
- Provides ShowBadge (disposable badge with count/text/priority) and Clear operations
- Reads from globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.Activity bridge

WorkbenchEditorService:
- Bridges VS Code's native editor service for pane management
- Provides Active (current editor snapshot), Open, CloseActive, and OnActiveChange stream

- OnActiveChange returns Stream of WorkbenchEditorChangeEvent with previous/current snapshots
- Problem ADT: WorkbenchEditorBridgeUnavailable, WorkbenchEditorOpenFailed, WorkbenchEditorCloseFailed

Both services follow the established Wind pattern with BridgeShape (upstream typed interface), Service (abstract contract), Tag (Context.Tag for DI), Problem (ADT for errors), and Live (runtime bridge implementation).

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add codegen emission layer for service schemas and catalog

Add the code emission layer to Wind's VS Code service codegen pipeline, completing Phase-2 of the system:

- Codegen.ts: Runnable entry point invoked by prepublishOnly.sh
- RunCodegen.ts: Orchestrator that walks source tree, extracts decorators, emits schemas
- EmitServiceSchema.ts: Per-service schema emitter - writes `<Decorator>Upstream.ts` files with typed interface members and source-line back-links
- EmitServiceCatalog.ts: Catalog emitter - writes ServiceCatalog.ts index of all discovered decorators with metadata
- index.ts: Public exports for library consumers

The emission layer takes the ServiceDecoratorRecord extraction results from Phase-1 and produces typed TypeScript files under Effect/Generated/ that Wind bridge shapes can import type from. Schema files are idempotent (byte-identical on re-run) with diff-friendly formatting: members sorted by source line, JSDoc preserved verbatim.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add VS Code service decorator codegen pipeline and global bridge accessor

Add a new regex-based codegen system that walks the VS Code source tree and extracts `createDecorator(...)` sites along with their interface members:

- `ExtractDecoratorMatch`: Captures decorator export names, tags, and JSDoc from `createDecorator<I<X>>('x')` patterns
- `ExtractInterfaceMembers`: Extracts typed interface members (properties, methods, events, getters, setters) with parameters and doc comments
- `IterateServiceDecorators`: Async iterator combining the walkers to yield one `ServiceDecoratorRecord` per decorator
- `SourceTreeWalker`: Async-iterator over VS Code TypeScript sources, skipping test/build/node_modules directories
- Typed records: `ServiceDecoratorRecord`, `InterfaceMemberRecord`, `CodegenProblem` ADT for error handling

Also adds `LandWorkbenchGlobal.ts` - a typed wrapper around `globalThis.__CEL_WIND__` that exposes `CELWind().RunPromise(...)` for Sky consumers without touching the raw global. Dispatches `cel:wind-ready` on installation.

This infrastructure enables automated Wind-side bridge shape generation from upstream VS Code source, with source-line back-links for traceability.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add LandWorkbench composition layer and WorkbenchWorkspace service

Add a new LandWorkbench composition layer that merges all previously-added workbench-tier services (WorkbenchClipboard, Command, Dialog, Host, Keybinding, Lifecycle, Notification, Storage, Theme) plus the new WorkbenchWorkspace service into a single Layer for convenient consumption by Sky.

Also adds WorkbenchWorkspaceService - a new service bridging VS Code's native IWorkspaceService. Provides Snapshot (workspace id, folders, configuration), Folders (array of workspace folders), FolderForResource (lookup folder by URI), and OnFolderChange (stream of folder add/remove/change events). The Live implementation reads from globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.Workspace and includes proper error handling via WorkbenchWorkspaceProblem ADT.

The LandWorkbenchLayer uses Layer.mergeAll so a failure in one service doesn't poison others, and LandWorkbenchRuntime provides a lazy singleton ManagedRuntime for efficient per-webview instantiation.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add WorkbenchClipboard, WorkbenchHost, and WorkbenchKeybinding services

Add three new workbench-tier Effect-TS service layers that bridge VS Code's native workbench services:

- WorkbenchClipboardService: Read/write text and resources via globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.Clipboard. Provides ReadText, WriteText, ReadResources, WriteResources with typed Problem ADT for bridge unavailability and operation failures.

- WorkbenchHostService: Host operations (reload, restart, close, focus, open window) via globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.Host. Includes OnDidChangeFocus stream for focus state changes.

- WorkbenchKeybindingService: Keybinding lookup and resolution via globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.Keybinding. Exposes Lookup, Resolve, and Chords stream for keybinding dispatch events.

Each service follows the established Wind pattern with Context.Tag, interface, Live implementation (runtime bridge), and Problem ADT for error cases. Also adds WorkbenchWorkspaceProblem type.

feat(Wind): Add UserSettings and WorkbenchStorage Effect-TS services

Add two new workbench-tier services that bridge VS Code's native IConfigurationService and IStorageService:

- UserSettingsService: Reads/writes user configuration via globalThis.__CEL_SERVICES__.Configuration and __CEL_OVERRIDE_CONFIG__. Supports Memory target for synchronous override writes and dispatches cel:user-settings-changed events. The Write path delegates to VS Code's updateValue for non-Memory targets.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add Vine notification stream service

Implement `VineNotifications` and `VineNotificationsLive` - an Effect-TS Layer that bridges Mountain's process-wide Vine notification broadcast to a `Stream<NotificationFrame>` consumable by Wind/Sky subscribers.

The Layer opens a Tauri channel via `vine_subscribe_notifications` command, draining the Mountain broadcast receiver into an unbounded Effect Queue. It wraps this in the `VineNotifications` service tag so consumers can `yield*` the stream and use Effect-TS operators like `Stream.filter`, `Stream.runForEach`, and `Stream.merge`.

Also adds:
- `SubscribeMethodPrefix` and `SubscribeMethod` convenience functions for filtering
- `SubscriberCount` diagnostic to query Mountain's active subscription count
- Proper acquireRelease bracket ensuring the Rust drain task exits when the Layer goes out of scope

Ref: Land/.claude/tauri/Patches/14-StreamingGRPC.md (P14.5)

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Use username in dev PostHog identifier fallback

The previous implementation used `Date.now()` in the PostHog identifier fallback, generating a different random seed for every editor launch. This made it difficult to correlate telemetry events from the same development machine across sessions.

Update the fallback logic to extract the username from `USER` or `USERNAME` environment variables, producing a stable `land-dev-wind-{Username}` identifier that persists across editor restarts.

This improves debuggability of development telemetry by allowing filtering by machine/username.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:

Add four new stub channel definitions to TauriMainProcessService's StubChannels to prevent "Unknown method" errors during workbench boot:

- `webview`: IWebviewManagerService stub - disables native menu shortcuts in electron but is no-op in Tauri's WKWebView
- `watcher`: IFileWatcherService stub - Land routes file watching via Mountain's FileWatcher.Register IPC instead
- `urlHandler`: IURLService stub - vscode:// URI handlers register through this; stub to no-ops for extensions calling registerUriHandler
- `download`: IDownloadService stub - extension gallery download path; returns undefined to surface "download not supported"

These stubs mirror the Output copy to maintain the Wind/Output lockstep rule. Without them, extensions or workbench services calling these channels hit undefined method paths during initialization.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add PostHog environment variable defines to ESBuild config

Add PostHogDefines to TargetConfig.ts that maps LAND_POSTHOG_* environment
variables to esbuild define directives. This enables the browser bundle to
access PostHog configuration (key, host, enabled flags, session recording,
surveys, distinct_id) at build time through import.meta.env.*.

The esbuild define directive is required because Wind's PostHog consumer
prefers import.meta.env over process.env, but browser contexts lack the
latter. This completes the work from the recent commit that removed the
hardcoded API key, enabling PostHog configuration to be driven entirely by
environment variables while preserving sensible defaults.

Message:

Add IPC stub for `extensionGalleryManifest` channel to support workbench's `setExtensionGalleryManifest({...})` call at boot. Also add `__initialize` to the playwright stub object.

Enhance stub-hit logging to track disposition: `value` for real payloads, `noop` for intentionally undefined stubs, and `drift` for keys missing from the stub object (potential sync issue between Wind and Output bundles). Uses `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call()` for reliable property checking.

This continues the channel-stub forensic work from recent releases, ensuring Wind's stub definitions stay lockstep with Output bundle IPC surface.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add localGit IPC routing and tauri-invoke timing instrumentation

- Route `localGit` channel to Mountain's `git:*` subprocess handlers, enabling VS Code's built-in git extension to work with Land's native git implementation
- Wrap InvokeMountain with per-invoke timing instrumentation that logs ok/fail and elapsed_ms to the dev-log sink, helping distinguish webview transport latency from Mountain handler slowness (Echo backlog, lock contention)
- Add Batch 6 IPC stubs for VS Code shared-process services: test, profileStorageListener, checksum, languagePacks, userDataSyncUtil, userDataSyncMachines, IUserDataSyncResourceProviderService, customEndpointTelemetry, process, remoteTunnel, sharedWebContentExtractor, playwright, v8InspectProfiling
- Add preload-shim diagnostic logging that surfaces which global keys are installed when running in Tauri vs non-Tauri hosts

These changes enable the built-in git extension to function while providing granular visibility into IPC latency.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Add IPC stubs for telemetryAppender and mcpGalleryManifest

Add no-op stubs for two high-frequency IPC channels that were causing
unnecessary Tauri round-trips:

- `telemetryAppender`: VS Code's TelemetryChannelAppender posts every
event through the shared-process channel. Land has no shared process or
telemetry backend, so each call fell through to
`InvokeMountain("undefined:log")`. Observed at 155 calls per boot in
`channel-stub` tag output - by far the hottest miss. The stub provides
`log`/`flush` no-ops so the appender short-circuits in the stub path.

- `mcpGalleryManifest`: MCP extension marketplace manifest bootstrap.
`channel-stub` surfaced this as the sole remaining `miss` per session.
The workbench calls `setMcpGalleryManifest({...})` once at boot; a no-op
stub is sufficient until Land has an MCP registry.

Also enhance `_DevLogForward` to send both casings (Tag/Message AND
tag/message) so Tauri's param-case handling doesn't require a guess -
the Rust command coalesces whichever arrived populated. Add fallback to
`__TAURI_INTERNALS__` for broader Tauri version compatibility.

Impact: Eliminates ~156 unnecessary Tauri IPC round-trips per editor
boot, reducing startup latency.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add dev-log forwarding from TypeScript to Mountain

Add a _DevLogForward helper that mirrors tagged log lines into Mountain's dev-log file sink via the RenderDevLog Tauri command. Integrate it into TauriChannel's three code paths:
- Fire-and-forget channel invocations
- Stub hits (when a mocked response is used)
- Misses (when neither route nor stub exists)

This enables `LAND_DEV_LOG=<tag> tail -f Mountain.dev.log` to capture TypeScript-originated IPC traffic alongside Rust dev_log! output for better local development debugging.

Message:

The stub returns empty shapes matching the expected interface, allowing
language detection to proceed without workspace-derived biases.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Align FileSystemProviderError names with VS Code's token format

Wind's FileSystemErrorCode uses key-like values ('FileNotFound', 'FileExists'), but VS Code's toFileSystemProviderErrorCode extracts the token from error.name and switches on 'EntryNotFound', 'EntryExists', etc. Add a mapping function VsCodeErrorCodeToken to translate between the two formats.

Also set this.name to the '<code> (FileSystemError)' pattern that VS Code's markAsFileSystemProviderError() expects. Remove individual name assignments from subclasses since the base class now handles naming.

Without this fix, mkdirp and validateWriteFile treat missing-file/dir errors as unknown and rethrow, surfacing as unhandled rejections like 'Unable to write file .../tasks.log (Error: Failed to stat file ...)'.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Add IPC stubs for unimplemented VS Code services

Several VS Code services invoked at runtime lack Mountain-side implementations,
causing IPC calls to return undefined. Downstream code then crashes when
attempting operations like .forEach(), .map(), or destructuring on undefined.

Add stub handlers in TauriMainProcessService for:
- extensionTipsService: Return empty arrays for recommendation queries
- mcpManagement/mcpWorkbenchManagement: Return empty arrays for server lists
- userDataSyncService: Return 'Uninitialised' status tuple [0, [], null]
- userDataSync: Return undefined for account/not-signed-in state
- userDataSyncStoreManagement: Return null
- userDataAutoSync: Return undefined for trigger/turnOn/turnOff
- languageDetection: Return null and empty extensions for detection

These stubs match the absence of corresponding backends in Land while
preventing crashes in VS Code code paths that expect valid return shapes.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Wind): Route colon-prefixed IPC methods through MountainIPCInvoke

Colon-prefixed method names (e.g., `file:write`, `shared_process:invoke`) cannot be registered as direct Tauri commands because Rust function names cannot contain colons. These methods must route through Mountain's single `MountainIPCInvoke` command, which unwraps the params back into the positional `Vec<Value>` that internal handlers consume.

This fix adds the routing logic to all Wind polyfills that invoke Tauri:
- ChildProcessPolyfill, FileProtocolShim, FileSystemPolyfill
- IPCRendererShim, NativeModulePolyfill, ProcessPolyfill
- SharedProcessProxy

Also updates TauriIPC.ts to use the consistent PascalCase form `"MountainIPCInvoke"` (matching all other call sites in Wind/Sky/Output) instead of the snake-case form. Minor style fixes in LifecycleService and PostHog/Fallback comments (em dash → hyphen).

All colon-prefixed IPC calls in Wind now route correctly through Mountain.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Wind): Split monolithic PostHogBridge into modular components

Refactor the single-file PostHogBridge.ts into separate modules under Source/Telemetry/PostHog/ with distinct responsibilities:
- Browser.ts: Lookup window.posthog client from Sky
- Configuration.ts: Read config from import.meta.env/process.env
- Fallback.ts: Direct fetch POST for node-side fallback
- Identifier.ts: Resolve distinct_id with seed support
- Properties.ts: Base event properties ($tier, $component, $lib)

PostHogBridge.ts now imports and composes these modules, reducing complexity while preserving identical runtime behavior. Each module is independently testable and has a single responsibility.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Wind): Add PostHog telemetry bridge for Wind-side events

Add Source/Telemetry/PostHogBridge.ts - a new telemetry module that enables
Wind to emit PostHog events. The bridge reuses Sky's existing window.posthog
instance when running in the webview (avoiding double-capture and rate-limit
issues), with a fallback to direct HTTP POST to the /batch endpoint for
Node.js environments (e.g., extension dev-loops).

Every event is tagged with $tier: "wind" so downstream analytics can filter
by source. Provides CaptureEvent, CaptureError, and Initialize functions.

Also includes a minor style fix in LifecycleService.ts (em dash → hyphen).

Enables Wind to contribute telemetry events to the unified PostHog pipeline.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Wind): Add SkyEvent registry and extend Channel registry with legacy channels

Add Source/IPC/SkyEvent.ts as a TypeScript mirror of the Rust SkyEvent enum in Element/Common/Source/IPC/SkyEvent.rs. This registry provides type-safe constants for all 95 Tauri event URIs that Mountain emits (e.g., "sky://extensions/installed"), replacing free-text strings in Wind service subscriptions.

Extend Channel.ts with three legacy channels that don't follow the `prefix:method` convention:
- `MountainGetStatus` ("mountain_get_status") — snake_case Tauri command
- `UserInterfaceShowOpenDialog` ("UserInterface.ShowOpenDialog") — dotted gRPC name
- `UserInterfaceShowSaveDialog` ("UserInterface.ShowSaveDialog") — dotted gRPC name

Relax the Channel registry type from `${string}:${string}` to `string` to accommodate these historical shapes. Update all call sites:
- MountainImplementation.ts: `mountain_get_status` → `Channel.MountainGetStatus`
- Files/Live.ts: ShowOpenDialog/ShowSaveDialog → Channel registry
- Workspaces/Live.ts: "sky://workspaces/changed" → `SkyEvent.WorkspacesChanged`

Also add ExtensionChangeStream.ts which merges the install/uninstall event streams into a single typed Effect-TS Stream, enabling the sidebar to subscribe to extension lifecycle changes via the SkyEvent registry.

Compile-time validation now catches drift between Mountain's emit URIs and Wind's subscribe calls.
